property_summary: When caller is approved, both reference and bug return true; when caller is not approved, reference returns false and bug returns true. Test uses a not-approved caller calling logGotRedemptionSignature and asserts the call returns false (reference behavior) vs true (bug).
change_summary: Replace `if (!approvedToLog(msg.sender)) return false;` with `if (!approvedToLog(msg.sender)) return true;` so the function always returns true even when the caller is not approved.
